name: Atmos Rewards Summit Visa Infinite Card

annual_fee.note: The card launched 2025-08-20 as a new premium product; the former mainstream Alaska Visa became Atmos Ascent, so its $99 companion-fare rules do not apply to Summit.

benefits.name: Alaska Lounge passes
benefits.enrollment_how: Needs an Atmos account; passes are issued to it.
benefits.qualifying: Alaska Lounges with eligible same-day travel; each pass covers one adult and up to two children under 21.
benefits.note: 8 passes a year, 2 per quarter, issued Jan. 1, Apr. 1, July 1 and Oct. 1 and expiring at quarter-end.

benefits.name: Wi-Fi passes
benefits.enrollment_how: Use the pass issued to the account.
benefits.note: 8 passes a year, 2 per quarter, expiring at quarter-end.

benefits.name: Lounge premium drinks
benefits.qualifying: Eligible Alaska Lounge signature cocktails and elevated bar selections.
benefits.note: 2 eligible drinks per visit; the published offer runs through 2026.

benefits.name: First checked bag
benefits.enrollment_how: Include the Atmos number and pay the airfare with the card.
benefits.qualifying: First bag for the holder and up to 6 companions on the same reservation, on eligible Alaska and Hawaiian flights.

benefits.name: Preferred boarding
benefits.enrollment_how: Include the Atmos number and pay the airfare with the card.
benefits.qualifying: Holder and up to 6 companions on eligible Alaska and Hawaiian flights.
benefits.note: Current Bank of America wording includes Hawaiian; some older reviews limit it to Alaska-operated flights.

benefits.name: Inflight purchase rebate (20%)
benefits.qualifying: Alaska onboard food, beverages and Wi-Fi (as described by Frequent Miler).
benefits.note: 20% back per eligible purchase; the cap was not found and the issuer's own confirmation was not found in accessible material.

benefits.name: Same-day confirmed change waiver
benefits.enrollment_how: Use the eligible linked card and account.
benefits.qualifying: Qualifying Alaska flights; restrictive fares may be excluded.
benefits.note: The change fee is waived; the issuer quotes savings of up to $75 for each eligible change.

benefits.name: Partner award booking-fee waiver
benefits.qualifying: Qualifying partner awards booked through Atmos.
benefits.note: The fee is omitted at award checkout. Its dollar amount is not published by Bank of America on the inspected page; launch-era references show $12.50 each way and newer coverage shows $20 each way.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Charge the application fee to the card.
benefits.qualifying: Eligible Global Entry or TSA PreCheck fee; NEXUS is not listed.
benefits.note: Up to $120, available once every 4 years.

benefits.name: Instant travel-delay credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Eligible booking, card and account details are required.
benefits.qualifying: Qualifying directly booked Alaska travel with a cancellation or a departure delay of 2+ hours; the voucher works only at eligible U.S. merchants.
benefits.note: Arrives as an emailed voucher that generally expires after 48 hours; not an ordinary statement credit. Not yet confirmed on the issuer's own page: shown as unverified.

benefits.name: Spending status points
benefits.qualifying: Eligible card purchases: 1 status point per $2, uncapped, counted in the status-qualification year.
benefits.note: The card does not confer automatic elite status. Published 2026 Atmos thresholds are Silver 20,000, Gold 40,000, Platinum 80,000 and Titanium 135,000 status points; card spending and anniversary points count toward them.

benefits.name: Bank of America relationship bonus
benefits.enrollment_how: Needs an eligible Bank of America account relationship.

benefits.name: Points sharing
benefits.qualifying: Eligible Atmos accounts: share with up to 10 additional members.

benefits.name: Visa Infinite hotel and rental privileges
benefits.qualifying: Participating hotel collection and rental partners.
benefits.note: Fixed credit or status values were not found in accessible issuer material. Rental-status descriptions conflict in secondary material and no tier is assumed.

certificates.name: Anniversary Global Companion Award
certificates.value_cap: 25,000-point discount on the companion's eligible award fare; points cover any excess and taxes and fees remain payable.
certificates.note: Needs an eligible award booking for two travelers on the same itinerary; eligible partner and premium-cabin awards count. Generally must be booked within 12 months of issuance and travel can happen later. Unused value is forfeited; cancellation normally restores the original expiration.

certificates.name: Spending Global Companion Award
certificates.value_cap: 100,000-point discount on the companion's eligible award fare; points cover any excess and taxes and fees remain payable.
certificates.note: Earned after $60,000 of eligible net purchases in the account anniversary year, not the calendar year. Same booking and forfeiture rules as the anniversary award.

certificates.name: Welcome Global Companion Award
certificates.value_cap: 25,000-point discount on the companion's eligible award fare.
certificates.note: Acquisition offer seen on the public page: after $4,000 of spending within 90 days. Not an annual benefit. A validity period for this award alone was not stated.

thresholds.unlocks: Acquisition offer: additional 25,000-point Global Companion Award after $4,000 of spending within 90 days.

values.value: Up to $75 (current Bank of America product terms).
